new_source_delta.epistemic_boundary: The gate validates equality to a precommitted source identity; it does not self-authenticate Git facts. The admitted executor must independently attest those facts and freeze the expected commitment before the model call.

integration_finding.claim: The current Trigger-2 selection probe can now be made repository/source-bound at component scope, while the current NODE_RESULT/atomic-cohort path binds packet/process/snapshot/cohort evidence but does not reference the exact source-bound model_call_identity or model_output_identity. Therefore the next canonical source closure is not another call-id scheme; it is deterministic propagation of the one already-bound call identity into the existing NODE_RESULT authority envelope and downstream cohort/evaluation/J-Space receipts.
integration_finding.anti_duplication_rule: Do not invent a second model-call identity. Reuse the exact source-bound Trigger-2 call identity as referenced immutable evidence inside the deterministic NODE_RESULT authority envelope.

hypothesis.H1: A fabric-owned reference from NODE_RESULT authority envelope -> exact source-bound model_call_identity + model_output_identity can close call-to-node provenance without teaching the model to mint authority IDs.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: A NODE_RESULT packet digest is sufficient because it already commits the semantic payload and process/snapshot evidence.
hypothesis.counterassessment: Packet integrity alone cannot distinguish two exact model calls that yield the same semantic payload, nor prove which checkpoint/input/runtime/source produced that payload. This matters for checkpoint selection, causal J-Space attribution and replay lineage.
hypothesis.cheapest_next_discriminator: Source-only successor fixture: extend the existing deterministic NODE_RESULT authority-envelope candidate with references to source_bound_model_call_identity_sha256 and model_output_identity_sha256 plus exact node/cell identity, then require packet/call transplant, call/cell transplant and source-head drift negatives to fail. Do not change the model-generated semantic payload schema.
